In October 2026, CISA added exactly 36 vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, reflecting a notable increase from the monthly average [[9]](https://varaxontech.com/guides/cisa-kev-report-october-2026), [[52]](https://varaxontech.com/guides/cisa-kev-report-october-2026). These additions were published across multiple alerts throughout the month, spanning a wide array of vendors and software products. 

The month began with the inclusion of CVE-2026-104286 affecting Fortinet FortiMail on October 1 [[36]](http:///go/v1/AejhnsW2wRuLawlc1AFu7vRa5TJea7O7-6c479hajiR6CHnaQSJMCulBi42-kBr5vErVogdBY1Tcp88eta5Z0XslypVjBkjcBrvDEnLnO38I0QvJqxwWS5c0KQxaeIfeFyzCFyLoUnS5gtFQ-xyEBk2vbbB84kJEGf0iuAIWRWPrRGfx738QaAWeyscVNG-UrmPkv3yJYL85pobux8OXgr7O1Es3el53IWepZjuGwX5O0cUdiKWDU-DLyISwLHd4t7e%5FTg5DRmVYTZYtB%5FfNy8a%5FQfhx866yDQ), [[91]](https://windowsforum.com/news/cisa-kev-adds-actively-exploited-fortimail-cve-2026-104286-urgent-patch-and-forensic-triage.446924/). Two days later, CISA added a critical zero-day chain targeting Zammad GmbH’s Zammad platform: CVE-2026-102489 (session fixation) and CVE-2026-102490 (improper privilege management), which together allow pre-authentication root access [[1]](http:///go/v1/AejhnsW2wRuLawlc1AFu7vRa5TJea7O7-6c479hagOJoPSpXQJYcsP6NksuyFNd%5F8Tu6bVd29Am2NcLfECPTVsiv1L3ry68SMz7jFCGbavWsuMi7HGFJOWoN0aEwtGNjjW2kNA9kAQTqJO%5FHDXcQAQCOeiys-gCdc2WBn-zEn1gUzmub3xbh8tzZsog6qxGhkg7rI98IBISHBwGxr3mNkZDvAas%5F6dpzne5qJyiRyvZcto7cgy%5FeSSf%5FHdka0qV0QaLNXeLa6UjbOb0B1xJPhzmrpDWEtn867MgH), [[138]](https://eastbaycyber.com/kev/added/2026-10-02/), [[140]](http:///go/v1/AYww2iM6Lz5-awlePAFE%5FdWdu5OCCmJasFhgCrUAha8b5%5FjDvopMs3-kgAyS7Vx4eJBZW6%5FsbQ0y6iPDOn40BLtczZdsjeETiglowMpNRkQ2UvB5Vb65S6duuoznyp68tjgWxDMckOh4GrFr1L87JdZ-K2LlcFoGFidD5abQvvMrvhGZa2iJG5kxJfFZ3G700lZBVy0ExOzp%5FwmgiFa4KnqffGHKZEkOWL2ZLDcg0TaI9FhlQMeYMqDdNotcEyXEJH391ZakS4PmOeTeNY1xJOJhkbJsI12IbTIL). On October 4, a memory buffer restriction flaw in Citrix NetScaler (CVE-2026-88779) was cataloged [[33]](http:///go/v1/AejhnsW2wRuLawlc1AFu7vRa5TJea7O7-6c479hajEX7A7mw%5F0%5FyoTNzlMYw-Q4l%5FaTekjeiLjI%5FKTIGk0rmcbfj-DIR-PWDtBaYk8BJi17v0ouQOhOQLEEMmN3%5FWodJYuYBncap1Ppspr80zkZ94EMtraQlHS6FFagijVxL0MBTT1WRdKkd5nbHwZfGrryikvW%5FBvmS2bT6UH8BcaM9ByqD7ufmR%5FImFlhDnivj3V56tZrdiA1oQQVA1BBLXZEvMo-htCP0aAoIr4wWk6-yFj9i3DpBGzvmAw), [[49]](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/10/04/cisa-adds-one-known-exploited-vulnerability-catalog). 

A significant batch of five legacy vulnerabilities was added on October 8, indicating renewed active exploitation of older flaws: CVE-2015-3306 (ProFTPD), CVE-2015-5477 (ISC BIND), CVE-2016-3081 (Apache Struts), CVE-2021-3199 (ONLYOFFICE Docs), and CVE-2023-22894 (Strapi) [[55]](https://eastbaycyber.com/kev/added/2026-10-08/). Mid-month additions included an Ivanti Connect Secure authentication bypass (CVE-2026-104935) and a Microsoft Windows command injection flaw (CVE-2026-96951) on October 13 [[7]](http:///go/v1/AejhnsW2wRuLawlc1AFu7vRa5TJea7O7-6c479hagoHHOA3sR9RS3RSrlRt0MOQOtj4e0FWp4wuG-N4DpcSxsBOUO5JOH3Ip2K33yKpawfR8Y6rKLTTFzxPTZ7LdZDByJlpikOPDXtfC0Ar9u3aAVuEBFuHmFy0VhavXe1Gnt8ggKyHVZhj3C9anxBh8vTWGYBSIwao0cE6SyLsHCi9lmeCHeUJBOuRZeAYqvx785kPoFWKMsoI40MNuTgj0L8HZCvO8pQnoU0%5Frp3%5FGcv7YJN9s6b4fQa4%5FkT8L), [[101]](http:///go/v1/ATLMaXHFQLNXawleAAGZfMal3x5Ds6DwI42wXUF5jkdVsZW3s9z0763RRLW9t-J4RMBrRzyzk0JZ2v9RnwK4qf5CHdk5Yobt9eAwdLNSUrhPE9IBjICgyENYnng8M4NWRcV6YPun2MximeedSP-H95ImV9p7L%5FmyPhaL5iCSuvNk6YJz8bOBwZMhaXxZTChtAz1I2PD90rgt7DPBm7rFy4XGqjiT9oqIVckCNletNa95LEpKHBwoNZiHCBmga6UWuS38WSXrlhLW%5FOi04nPT59T3Lf10lZYWSLAG), [[205]](https://windowsforum.com/news/windows-october-2026-patch-triage-prioritize-exploited-cve-2026-96951-over-cvss-and-epss.450022/). The following day, CISA cataloged four vulnerabilities: CVE-2026-0322 in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS, CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134 in Ahsay AhsayCBS, and CVE-2026-76519 in Cisco Secure Email Gateway [[10]](http:///go/v1/AejhnsW2wRuLawlc1AFu7vRa5TJea7O7-6c479hag0IzvWmr%5F41GHDNGcEDetLmqsM36psEeQhjIWLP1cmT77PuJjhMWhdP4T9p0s26baqX2KQCIfRLSo9AVEgGO3xm%5FlaCT6MnZ5fp5BA46H77zlDMQQfIJg%5FvAkx3HOamtaGzsxXhTZJjDCnXqvIQtuYIMu1OGQlQhthc9pMbLHRtaXOtk%5FrHRrJgJhFHAOeWThEksHWoppNtGKf1rqm8r9%5F%5F3Lq19y3KV2BduTYZPnO1s6k6F6EfATJpx7hRbAQ), [[56]](http:///go/v1/AcCofDmNy2Ccawlc1AEwqT57wmPO-1VQXBnSsK6xhA8BQOiEo7b%5FghbJ0UBtxqh%5FckuYTyuE-BupNt6kz2grUOh4iRHeQCOWDd4kp8%5FeVl0VEh%5FF-gnNURTb8E0Z4J3w580y6-BjpPoba13BQdQ5v8sJwkbQsC9jiSBQXXAm046p-c%5FmE0fB%5FHs8etf4w24PsAK4dTAMnYMMoyDwNzIuQugBCIRq6qYLJpgafK55OXvsQnOz9PYaPskjWVL260xtFOp%5FEZNKUjH0uKdt6SfnJbmuYbj0h8qXg%5FXKDg), [[212]](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/10/14/cisa-adds-four-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog). An additional entry on October 14 covered CVE-2026-21589 in Atlassian Multiple Products [[28]](http:///go/v1/AejhnsW2wRuLawlc1AFu7vRa5TJea7O7-6c479haimvjeocV5P5e5pIrl-pqef92hkQerKGJn3AEWPrX8U5vOc6lQmgHUDPcIZc1TbGwrMm-HhVvi8gLejsTcP4dn1m8fsq2dH4iYqPoYsrwS26QaV6wrvzgqEg4bD2Djn8cCmn-Ce0WojmQ0Q2nIIEPR2Ic2HnIw3xWxWvED16fEhaeaZ9XHtxEoDq0eMniekY-ppnilxr8H3ZgTq3zd7SMCyGx%5FxH3-H47Ih0bJquNd1L-fPvEfOnISLXXCA), [[53]](http:///go/v1/AcCofDmNy2Ccawlc1AEwqT57wmPO-1VQXBnSsK6xg2APz68Jz2Z73sWrFC7siY3U1js6-wU9HBkJBXQXTb6NqpTHlb7An7bbmpU2Vq-oZh%5F1-U7Zv6d7v1H6afH0lxWVNhawknk8fKMN9f9iuJtbX9uohxJkSFRgPPcZXGVhtRy6t2RmBNFgy3kbXzV8yw1hXCno2M2TjjzLVof%5F3PsxtfwMAZRegKqTiVEjJnXl4mjAtP9yVzYde4w0Zr%5FHTFcz1wii878YKtZ9-ZVjMuX69519o7dHkGpDBg). 

On October 16, CVE-2025-61624 (Fortinet Multiple Products) and CVE-2026-102764 (BeyondTrust Remote Support) were added [[19]](http:///go/v1/AejhnsW2wRuLawlc1AFu7vRa5TJea7O7-6c479hahsAdvvr%5FBtqsmxR7LSNavADLXlV0ItT8ggDlyC3XFUkhy9iD53oCg8dZa94LdsPz19iE1PkwzSNaT6avjz5HUHR4hp2lsKkNjGUTW5glZ2C-h%5FzXdmIFUz5iGlOnJqPp8BO836KxHQWbc1Ah8JHHCOoL3CH-N-jWygxlh%5FguZHPSrsCGcUs3C%5FBRY7%5FeJQ4ip0y0KajQjx5EVxOItpoOGvyYCpRdpZTl7Veon9d1UOBU0S7RjKd5C8hVaVgF), [[59]](http:///go/v1/AcCofDmNy2Ccawlc1AEwqT57wmPO-1VQXBnSsK6xhVY4%5FKkNwdWtafY-j8EuMEMSZtETmK6taod5qth20DyOxB4-sGgwkdsbt0hmLGw1MfC9yQO-f5MRJ0Etlcw1PZQjFWC0o1Icx36X6nXKl0QqWFkTgIlQhLyhjU-YKPEZSi88QdryYvtXQupyrkIgw2EO2zOhNyZafoHL1PJmv7v1lKjUF%5FFMgOa2rVJsGzxxJFZKbKpZySEqstIr0nmeGc8l-fve8V-zjzrr52GJkjggJBbDPQ9jScyLUksP). October 23 brought CVE-2026-114625 (Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator) and CVE-2026-110447 (Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server) [[39]](http:///go/v1/AejhnsW2wRuLawlc1AFu7vRa5TJea7O7-6c479hakG8OZU56RzBQfHUph8JCQYxJ1ihH1YITf863mRMeL-lqnNvJLzpnBZvTHtc3QcYyi%5F4-aHbKBCAp5t0YkSTHCfUTcU6CSF7Rqzq8ZJ3toKG9MgH-9aTPfFKdnZJH6Cmmhj0NJwZuw8iEx-wkhUmIgavzYYpvmYn1mThooUgj-W74bKefARaDpG%5F2d%5FQBU5SILhpq-ImXkuGhDa2K7lsmgBwDuAPfmoX0Ba-4iDa%5FTlAlDBMgaYX9mXD4Aw), [[42]](http:///go/v1/AejhnsW2wRuLawlc1AFu7vRa5TJea7O7-6c479hakyY8OsVkjLJwRxbmNd7VjCGcB39G7SLMU023%5FrFnwDVP-judFgM9eL6bp8xAKNZ1-V2oMZtk0F%5FesCyaHhftoXzevZMW1HeA15PKNOlkpos%5Fy48eq4CZeChZqyoLoutQoHo7XSvkgDkc4Kyg1Oflq5a96MXoH8pdDCaz%5FLBt2pJZ4brmK9wH4NUdFIM-E00iItD1aRWkrJTRU6kOaiW7d8wk0jP0VWF7NF2ZmcNQ%5F4Z4yElRSrpUdiEsRbcN). 

Late October featured high-profile additions. On October 26, the critical PHP2Shell chain comprising CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (PHP Group PHP) was cataloged [[18]](https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/USDHSCISA/bulletins/4309083), [[193]](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/10/21/critical-vulnerabilities-php-require-immediate-patching), [[195]](https://www.tenable.com/blog/php2shell-cve-2026-109618-cve-2026-109619-frequently-asked-questions-about-critical-php-remote). October 27 added CVE-2026-111497 (Google Brotli) and CVE-2026-48356 (Adobe Commerce and Magento) [[186]](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/10/27/cisa-adds-two-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog), [[191]](https://circuits.fit/articles/cisa-kev-magento-brotli-velocloud.html). On October 28, CISA listed CVE-2026-41709 (Broadcom VMware ESX) and the Linux kernel flaw CVE-2026-46300 (Fragnesia), which threat actors chained with the PHP vulnerabilities to achieve root access [[4]](http:///go/v1/AejhnsW2wRuLawlc1AFu7vRa5TJea7O7-6c479hagTKUhY0PRA6XJZxlCTrjcNUq3I2NeHLSwWuuoIqf%5FY3pqdrJfOPVbssZ9vXuZDgWFmNo3cM3rCwXeMDUiog9MySmN36AXoMUItihmwXoh%5F7BgJel3p2ktAEANLy7z479hUcqEgd0HkCAXBXuujowOdVg64RfdeDA1uAN%5FmwxZsSbSoLI79AQ8EtHQKEhbfVfJYOW6yPlyMv3tBc5%5FYpyYdgiwR9WGoUqwEDQjElBKuJcc36l-UNq%5FVMw%5FNUA), [[117]](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/10/28/cisa-adds-two-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog), [[119]](https://thecircuitry.to/article/cisa-adds-linux-kernel-cve-2026-46300-to-kev-federal-fix-due-oct-31-mvsl0prv), [[122]](https://cipherssecurity.com/linux-fragnesia-cve-2026-46300/). October 29 saw CVE-2026-97229 (GitLab Community/Enterprise Edition) and CVE-2026-76418 (Cisco Secure Firewall ASA/FTD Software) [[6]](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/10/29/cisa-adds-two-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog), [[22]](http:///go/v1/AejhnsW2wRuLawlc1AFu7vRa5TJea7O7-6c479hah4xxp8rrpAaX0kb%5FnDdxK8ZEE-4AR4ksYVBiYlB5GUGEF0MWdENvM68juXlm3T9nL92QqC9WA7SjBJAImLC6OWTJiezQvCExCPB09YV6%5FtXWWAN3QAV7-zLFw7BnPxsLefm2bRMpdSK3g5eV-d5BPbhyy7-jAS144o4B5n60bVBq%5FvJz8cclP0oECUGwDHUYY6ctii9Nlnc3%5Fi3Iqiq6Gso42daLHsCkXxNxPAT43OfcvrpYuEju8Mwe83YJ), [[120]](http:///go/v1/AUDVKWISqjidawleAAGcZSK4zBAiAxvfexNksXllg6YE-kxXnW7hZy9wQrheXcw20i7Db-3UlJID9belf774pb6DYbh8FQXd0CoKLdhVCKDCRTuKxWtLiUzFWploW33q6EsvWNcryJQ2y0ygHFqZGhUCJoUPYYhFNEui9JVKvsMQ3A-Cdpjbd1K6HCtkNHkiNEdFLbp4XL1DiKulzGhZjznomdGUgU9G8Z4gkTaAUHw-Vw4bazHJkvjWYsV7iPNTkwKNrCb%5FSIw2983gksFps8aJZvI647VjLjsB).
